//: THE TEST SUITE HAS NEVER BEEN TYPECHECKED.
tsconfig.json excludes src/**/*.test.ts and src/**/*.test.tsx, so `bunx tsc
--noEmit` -- one of the four gates every lane runs before every commit --
has never looked at a single test file. `bun test` transpiles without
checking, so nothing else looks at them either.
S4 found the same hole in e2e/ and proved it with a deliberate bad
annotation that tsc reported ZERO times. Four of the five errors hiding
there were reading fields off types that did not have them, in the checks
being used to judge other lanes' code.
MEASURED HERE, 2026-08-28: 424 type errors across 185 files. Mutation-
tested the same way -- a deliberate bad annotation produces exactly one
error and removing it returns zero -- so the config works and the 424 are
real.
IT IS NOT A GATE YET AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Failing every lane on 424
pre-existing errors is how a check gets reverted rather than fixed; the
repo's own Meridian ratchet exists because somebody already learned that.
This makes the number visible and runnable by name (`bun run
typecheck:tests`) so it can be driven down and then gated, which is the
order that survives.
Its own config rather than widening the root include, following S4's e2e
precedent: test files are Bun code and src is browser code, and one
`types` field cannot be right for both.
